name: LinearPlayoutScheduleGrid
tagline: Plan, check and lock linear TV channel schedules – grid, EPG and compliance in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete broadcast scheduling app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: a channel × time schedule grid with drag and drop, a rules engine for watershed, rights windows, overlaps, gaps, repeats, ad minutes and EPG text, an EPG guide with export, bulk status workflow and Lock day for playout.
features: Broadcast-day timeline per channel with drag & drop and keyboard moves
Watershed, rights-window, overlap, gap, repeat, ad-minute and EPG checks
Draft → Proposed → Approved → Locked → Aired workflow with rules
Lock day / Unlock day with readiness checklist
Bulk status, scheduler and cancel with undo
EPG guide with character limits and CSV export
Phone layout with agenda and bottom navigation
